text: A Song of Ascents; of David. Jehovah,{H3068} my heart{H3820} is not haughty,{H1361} nor mine eyes{H5869} lofty;{H7311} Neither do I exercise{H1980} myself in great matters,{H1419} Or in things too wonderful{H6381} for me.
Surely I have stilled{H7737} and quieted{H1826} my soul;{H5315} Like a weaned{H1580} child with his mother,{H517} Like a weaned child{H1580} is my soul{H5315} within me.
O Israel,{H3478} hope{H3176} in Jehovah{H3068} From this time forth and for{H5704} evermore.{H5769}
